scenes.label: Jidoka: Free to Move On

captionRanges.spoken: How do you know your organization is using AI well?
When teams are more freed than constrained by what they build.

scenes.action: Fully composed title, matched called-by-stop painting, CI stop and question at frame zero; the answer follows on the same representative artwork.

scenes.label: Bound to yesterday

captionRanges.spoken: Too often, software ties its creators down.
Yesterday’s output blocks today’s higher-value work.

scenes.action: Fit the full burden painting, preserving the stack, tethered people and distant doorway; no new red trail over people.

scenes.label: Toyota Production System

captionRanges.spoken: TPS is the Toyota Production System.
Jidoka is one of its two pillars.

scenes.action: Reconstruct the deck TPS house in English, highlighting only the Jidoka pillar in vermilion.

scenes.label: Human wisdom, built in

captionRanges.spoken: Jidoka: automation with a human touch.
A broken thread stops the loom.
Human wisdom lives in the mechanism.

scenes.action: Play the local loom schematic once from the beginning. The broken thread drops its plate, blocks the detector and stops the drive. Freeze the fully visible stopped pose at 9s, before the source fade. The outlined kanji sits beneath the loom; only the person radical is red.

scenes.label: Called by the stop

captionRanges.spoken: Instead of watching the loom—or CI…

scenes.action: Fit both complete paired paintings at identical geometry and crossfade over 0.6s. Cover their embedded terminal screen planes with authored CI CHECKING and CI STOP displays.

scenes.label: Solve. Preserve. Protect.

captionRanges.spoken: Solve the problem. Preserve the judgment.
Build known rules into simple checks that stop the work.
Leave clear evidence for the next person—or AI.

scenes.action: Dry typography accumulates solved human judgment, known rules and simple checks with evidence. No toy software example or automatic diagnosis/repair.

scenes.label: Keep as little as possible

captionRanges.spoken: The best part is no part.
Remove unnecessary parts. Preserve needed behavior.

scenes.action: Remove redundant outlines while the necessary behavior and self-protection remain visible.

scenes.label: Free to move on

captionRanges.spoken: Free yourself for the next problem that matters.

scenes.action: Keep the unattended checks, all faces, hands and shared prototype in the full fitted painting; attention belongs to the next valuable problem.

scenes.label: Free to Move On
scenes.action: Hold the settled freedom image, title, genuine logo and exact credit for three seconds while the score fades.
